title: IntelliType Elite config
description: See Config.cs for the C# side of this shape. Hot-reloaded by ConfigWatcher.cs on save.

vendorId.description: USB vendor ID, e.g. "0x045E" (Microsoft). Changing this requires an app restart -- it governs which HID collections get opened at startup.

productId.description: USB product ID, e.g. "0x008A" (Wireless Desktop Elite receiver). Changing this requires an app restart.

reportId.description: HID report ID the wheel's delta reports arrive on.

deltaByteOffset.description: Byte index (including the report ID byte at 0) holding the signed wheel delta.

notchSize.description: Windows mouse-wheel notch size (WHEEL_DELTA is 120); multiplied by the raw HID delta.

layout.description: Optional. Your ShareMouse monitor arrangement, so the app can tell when the Mac is active: the Windows cursor parks on the PC-screen edge facing the Mac, and a macAction is used while it's there. Omit to disable Mac mode.

monitors.description: Rows, top to bottom; each row lists items left to right. Exactly one "windows" monitor (this PC's primary screen). Rows stack directly: a row starts where the tallest monitor of the row above ends.

items.description: "windows:3840x2160" or "macos:3840x2160" (x, X or * as the separator), or "none:25%": an inline empty gap, 25% of the first monitor's width in the first row, pushing the next item right.

mouseDebounce.description: Suppresses spurious repeat clicks from a worn mouse switch, system-wide -- unrelated to the keyboard's HID buttons above. Optional; omit entirely to leave disabled.

enabled.description: Master switch for mouse click debounce. Off by default.

threshold.description: In milliseconds. Suppress a second click of this button within this many ms of the first, as a hardware-bounce filter. Keep well below GetDoubleClickTime (~500ms default) or real double-clicks get eaten. Tens of ms is typical.

name.description: Free-form identifier, used in log output and to track press/release state.

reportId.description: HID report ID this button's press/release bit is reported on.

byteOffset.description: Byte index (including the report ID byte at 0) containing this button's bit.

bitMask.description: Single-bit mask within the byte at byteOffset, e.g. "0x20".

macAction.description: Used instead of 'action' and every override while the Mac is the active ShareMouse machine (see 'layout'). Only Keystroke, Sequence and None are honored; a button without a macAction does nothing in Mac mode.

modifierOverrides.description: Checked when no appOverrides entry matches the foreground app.

appOverrides.description: Keyed by process name (with or without .exe, case-insensitive), e.g. "OUTLOOK". Matched against the foreground window at press time. Each entry has its own default action plus its own optional modifierOverrides.

modifiers.description: One or more of shift/ctrl/alt/win joined with '+', e.g. "shift" or "ctrl+shift". Matched against live modifier state (GetAsyncKeyState) at the moment the button is pressed. When several entries could match, the one requiring the most modifiers wins.

type.description: None: no-op (still logged). Keystroke: SendInput with 'keys'. Sequence: runs 'steps' in order on a background task (keystrokes, typed text, pauses); one sequence at a time, a press while one runs is ignored. Launch: Process.Start with 'path'/'args'. CloseWindow: posts WM_SYSCOMMAND/SC_CLOSE to the foreground window (the same command Alt+F4 triggers internally) -- more reliable than simulating Alt+F4 for apps like packaged/UWP Calculator that don't always react to a synthetic keypress. ShowFavorites: pops up an overlay listing the MyFavorites1-5 buttons' current assignments; only meaningful on the button labeled 'Show Favorites'.

keys.description: Only used when type is "Keystroke". '+'-joined combo, e.g. "ctrl+shift+t" or a single key like "F5". Supports ctrl/control, alt, shift, win/windows, cmd/command (the Windows key, which ShareMouse maps to Cmd on the Mac), esc/escape, tab, enter/return, space, backspace, delete, insert, home, end, pageup, pagedown, left/right/up/down, [ and ], single letters/digits, and F1-F24.

steps.description: Only used when type is "Sequence". Run in order, e.g. cmd+space, wait, type an app name, wait, enter -- launches a Mac app via Spotlight.

path.description: Only used when type is "Launch". Executable path or URL passed to Process.Start.

args.description: Only used when type is "Launch". Optional command-line arguments.

step.description: One step of a Sequence. A step may set several of these; they run in the order keys, text, delayMs.

keys.description: Same combo syntax as a Keystroke action's 'keys', e.g. "cmd+space".

text.description: Typed one key at a time. Letters, digits and spaces only (no shift, no punctuation); sent lowercase.

delayMs.description: Pause after this step, in milliseconds. Spotlight needs roughly 300ms to open before typing and ~250ms before Return.
